authenticity_review: The image demonstrates strong rendering quality with realistic fur texture and consistent lighting. However, several AI artifacts reduce authenticity: (1) The white heart marking on the left horse has soft, airbrushed edges that lack individual hair definition at the boundary; (2) A faint illegible text/watermark artifact exists in the bottom-left corner; (3) The expert pose auditor flagged 71% low-confidence keypoints, indicating latent anatomical distortions in limbs and joints that are partially obscured by cropping but affect structural integrity. The 'darken' distortion noted by the quality auditor appears to be stylistic vignetting rather than technical error. These issues collectively prevent a higher authenticity score despite excellent visual appeal.
